rows.mainnet_release_reason: Read-only N3Index verification confirmed AAAddressMarket, its live eventless business ABI, getListingCount=0, and canonical UnifiedSmartWalletV3 integration. No funded write was submitted.

Read-only getcontractstate verified MiniAppBreakupPact, the complete pact/credit ABI and events, deployed NEF checksum 2044887039, and a HALT lastPactId read. No write was submitted during this frontend pass.
MiniAppCouncilGovernance ABI, isPaused=false, getProposalCount=0, and platform constants were verified through read-only N3Index RPC.

Read-only N3Index verification confirmed MiniAppDailyCheckin, NEF checksum 170189676, the complete check-in/claim ABI and events, isPaused=false, 0.001 GAS fee, 0.01/0.02 GAS milestones, and a 1.002 GAS reward pool.
Dedicated contract restored, audited for update coverage, deployed to mainnet, and smoke-tested with create/issue/check-in.
Legacy 28-method contract is deployed and its existing escrow lifecycle remains usable. New escrow creation is frontend-blocked until the recovery-capable contract update is deployed and verified.
MiniAppMultisig name, live ABI, and zero-state ID reads were verified through read-only RPC.
Official NameService ABI, NNS symbol, totalSupply=3906, 5-character price=2 GAS, availability, and neo.neo properties were verified through read-only N3Index RPC.
MiniAppNeoPay ABI (8 required methods and 3 confirmation events), totalStreams=12, isPaused=false, and stream 12 were verified through read-only N3Index RPC.
MiniAppNeoPay ABI, totalStreams=12, isPaused=false, and getStreamDetails(12) were verified through read-only N3Index RPC.
Legacy contract is deployed and readable, but lacks direct-asset credit recovery ABI; the frontend keeps prepaid funding writes browse-only until a recovery-capable deployment is verified.
Dedicated contract restored, audited for update coverage, deployed to mainnet, and smoke-tested with template/issue/revoke.
Read-only getcontractstate and lastCapsuleId verification confirmed the deployed MiniAppTimeCapsule ABI and a HALT response. Fresh funded write validation remains pending.
